stemMd: A function has domain all real numbers and satisfies f(x + 4) = f(x) for every x. If f(1) = 7, which value must also be 7?
explanationMd: Repeatedly applying the four-unit relation gives f(1) = f(5) = f(9) = f(13). The condition guarantees equality at inputs differing by multiples of four, but does not require equality at other offsets.

distractorRationale.b: A shift of one is not guaranteed by the stated period.
distractorRationale.d: A shift of two is not guaranteed.
distractorRationale.e: A shift of three from one is not guaranteed.
distractorRationale.c: The given relation does not force a shift of one.
